phase_prompt.label: Phase 1
phase_prompt.summary: Earth in its natural state with faint glyphs and a nascent green vector grid; cracks begin to form.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic depiction of Earth’s surface in its natural state, with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs subtly etched into the continents, a faint green vector grid emerging over the oceans, a valley floor with a perfect straight crack revealing a black void filled with data stars, all under harsh sunlight, 8K, 9:16.
